tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Alternative complete integral for the eikonal equation] ↗ def:general-integral 1. ch3:3.1-ex-5\group Nonlinear First-Order PDE

In two dimensions, \[ u(x,a_1,a_2)=x_1\cos a_1+x_2\sin a_1+a_2 \] is a complete integral of $|Du|=1$. Taking $a_2=0$ and enveloping in $a_1$ gives $u=\pm |x|$ away from the origin. \end{example}
